source_title: TEXAS COMMUNITY BANCSHARES, INC. AND THE BANC OF SAN JACINTO COUNTY BANCSHARES, INC., THE PARENT OF THE BANK OF SAN JACINTO COUNTY, COLDSPRING, TEXAS, ANNOUNCE MERGER AGREEMENT
source_excerpt:
MINEOLA, Texas and COLDSPRING, Texas , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Texas Community Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: TCBS ) (the "Company") and The Banc of San Jacinto County Bancshares, Inc. ("SJCB") jointly announced today that they have entered into a definitive merger agreement (the "Merger Agreement"). Under the agreement, the Company will acquire SJCB in an all-cash transaction (the "Merger"). This includes SJCB's wholly owned subsidiary, The Bank of San Jacinto County, a Texas non-member bank headquartered in Coldspring, Texas ("SJCB Bank").
Founded in 1963, SJCB Bank is headquartered in Coldspring, the county seat of San Jacinto County, Texas. For more than six decades, SJCB Bank has served as a community-focused institution committed to the financial well-being and growth of the communities it serves. The bank offers retail and commercial banking services from its single banking office in Coldspring. It is led by Chief Executive Officer, Denny Clark. As of June 30, 2026, SJCB Bank reported total assets of $41.951 million, total loans of $12.515 million and total deposits of $35.305 million.
"We are pleased to welcome SJCB Bank, its customers and its employees to our organization," said Jason Sobel, President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company. "This transaction is a natural extension of our strategy to grow thoughtfully in markets we know and understand, and it brings together two institutions that share a deep commitment to relationship-based community banking. SJCB Bank has earned the trust of San Jacinto County over more than 60 years, and we intend to honor that legacy. We believe this combination will give SJCB Bank's customers access to a broader range of products, services and lending capacity, while creating long-term value for our shareholders."
Denny Clark, Chief Executive Officer of SJCB Bank, stated, "For more than six decades, SJCB Bank has been proud to serve the families and businesses of San Jacinto County, and that mission has guided every decision we have made, including this one. After careful consideration, our board concluded that joining Texas Community Bancshares is the right step for our shareholders, our customers and our employees. We share the same values and the same belief in local, personal service. We are confident that, as part of a larger organization, we will be able to serve our community even more effectively for years to come."
Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, SJCB's shareholders will receive aggregate cash consideration of $9.5 million (the "Aggregate Merger Consideration"). At closing, each outstanding share of SJCB common stock will be converted into the right to receive a pro rata portion of the Aggregate Merger Consideration in cash.
The boards of directors of both the Company and SJCB have unanimously approved the Merger Agreement. The Merger is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027. Closing is subject to customary closing conditions, including receipt of required regulatory approvals and approval of the Merger Agreement by SJCB's shareholders.
Alston & Bird LLP is serving as legal counsel to the Company. Fenimore Kay Harrison LLP is serving as legal counsel to SJCB, and Performance Trust Capital Partners, LLC is serving as financial advisor to SJCB.
About Texas Community Bancshares, Inc. Texas Community Bancshares, Inc. is headquartered in Mineola, Texas. It is the bank holding company for Broadstreet Bank, SSB, a Texas-chartered savings bank also headquartered in Mineola ("Broadstreet"). Broadstreet offers a range of deposit products, including checking, money market, savings and certificate of deposit accounts. Its lending covers residential real estate, commercial real estate, construction and land, and municipal loans, along with commercial, consumer and other loans. Broadstreet serves customers through its main office and six branch offices in Franklin, Hopkins, Smith, Van Zandt and Wood Counties in East Texas. Texas Community Bancshares is traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market Exchange under the symbol "TCBS."
About The Banc of San Jacinto County Bancshares, Inc. The Banc of San Jacinto County Bancshares, Inc. is the holding company for The Bank of San Jacinto County, Coldspring, Texas. The bank is a full-service bank with one location in Coldspring, San Jacinto County, Texas. The Bank of San Jacinto County, Coldspring, Texas has been a true community bank serving the needs of the San Jacinto County community since 1963.
